# Kyoto 4-Day Temple Trip Plan
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/2/23/Exterior_facade_of_Kannon_Hall_Buddhist_temple_with_Goshikimaku_Buddhist_flags_Ninna-ji_Kyoto_Japan.jpg Alt=Kyoto 4-Day Temple Trip Plan, Kyoto, Japan

A balanced Kyoto itinerary for **2 adults** with **good transit access**, **temple highlights**, and **one slower day** built in. Budget here covers **food + local transport only** and stays well within your **$1,800 total**.

## Day-by-Day Kyoto Itinerary

### Day 1 — April 10: Higashiyama Welcome Walk
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- **Morning:** Arrive, check in, then start at **Kiyomizu-dera** and walk the old streets of Higashiyama.
- **Afternoon:** Visit **Kodai-ji** and **Yasaka Shrine**, then pause in Gion for tea.
- **Evening:** Keep it light with a riverside dinner near **Kamo River**.
- **Food:** Simple soba set, tofu dishes, or a casual yudofu dinner.

### Day 2 — April 11: Arashiyama Temple Circuit
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- **Morning:** Go early to **Tenryu-ji** and the **Bamboo Grove** before tour groups build up.
- **Afternoon:** Cross to **Okochi Sanso Garden** or add **Jojakko-ji** for a quieter temple stop.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/9/99/Wooden_gate_in_Okochi_Sanso_Garden%2C_Kyoto%2C_Japan.jpg Alt=Afternoon:** Cross to **Okochi Sanso Garden** or add **Jojakko-ji** for a quieter temple stop, Kyoto, Japan
- **Evening:** Return by train and have dinner near Kyoto Station for easy transit.
- **Food:** Bento lunch, tofu cuisine, or a noodle shop near the station.

### Day 3 — April 12: Relaxed Central Kyoto Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/moon-stars.svg
- **Morning:** Sleep in, then visit **Nijo Castle** or a single temple such as **Shoren-in** at an easy pace.
- **Afternoon:** Spend time in **Kyoto Imperial Palace Park** or a café break in central Kyoto.
Media: Alt=Afternoon:** Spend time in **Kyoto Imperial Palace Park** or a café break in central Kyoto, Kyoto, Japan
- **Evening:** Optional low-key shrine visit or shopping around **Shijo/Kawaramachi**.
- **Food:** Café breakfast, lunch set, and a relaxed izakaya or kaiseki-lite dinner.

### Day 4 — April 13: Northern Temples and Departure Buffer
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/map.svg
- **Morning:** Visit **Kinkaku-ji** early, then continue to **Ryoan-ji** for a quieter temple contrast.
Media: Alt=Morning:** Visit **Kinkaku-ji** early, then continue to **Ryoan-ji** for a quieter temple contrast, Kyoto, Japan
- **Afternoon:** If time allows, add **Ninna-ji** or head back for packing and transit.
- **Evening:** Keep this as a flexible departure day with a final Kyoto meal.
- **Food:** Light breakfast, lunch near the temple route, and a final ramen or set meal.

## Budget and Pace Plan

| Day | Food for 2 | Local Transport for 2 | Daily Total | Pace |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Apr 10 | $70 | $18 | $88 | Moderate |
| Apr 11 | $75 | $24 | $99 | Active |
| Apr 12 | $65 | $16 | $81 | Relaxed |
| Apr 13 | $60 | $20 | $80 | Flexible |
| Trip Total | $270 | $78 | $348 | Within budget |

### What this means
- Your likely spend on **food + local transport** is about **$348 total for 2 adults**.
- That leaves a large cushion inside your **$1,800 budget** for lodging, temple entry fees, snacks, and souvenirs.
- Kyoto transit is easy to manage with **IC card tap-in/tap-out** and a mix of buses + trains.

## Crowd-Avoiding Tips for Kyoto

- Start popular temples **right at opening**; this matters most for **Kiyomizu-dera, Tenryu-ji, and Kinkaku-ji**.
- Visit major sights on **weekday mornings** when possible; your trip already benefits from **April 10 and 13** being less crowded than peak weekend periods.
- Use **train access over buses** when available, especially for **Arashiyama** and central Kyoto connections.
- Build in one **slow day** like April 12 so you are not temple-hopping at peak hours every day.
- For photos and a calmer experience, aim for **late afternoon after tour buses thin out**.
- Keep one or two temples per half-day instead of stacking too many stops.

## Helpful Kyoto Trip Resources

- Kyoto tourism guidance: https://kyoto.travel/en
- Temple opening and access checks: https://www.japan-guide.com/e/e2158.html
